sql: WITH despesa AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa FROM educacao_educacao WHERE ano_referencia = 2023), receita AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2023 AND dsc_especie ILIKE '%Imposto%') SELECT (d.total_despesa / NULLIF(r.total_receita, 0)) * 100 AS ieq_c, CASE WHEN (d.total_despesa / NULLIF(r.total_receita, 0)) * 100 >= 25 THEN 'Sim' ELSE 'Não' END AS atingiu_minimo FROM despesa d CROSS JOIN receita r;
